evidence: Cic. Fam. 7.32.1: omnia omnium dicta … in mē cōnferrī
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “something said, i. e. a saying, a word”; often a witty one, as in Cicero’s letter. To comment on something is to say something about it: dē eā rē dīcere (see say).

phrases.latin: ais enim, ut ego discesserim, omnia omnium dicta … in mē cōnferrī
phrases.english: for you say that since I left, every witty remark anyone makes is being put down to me
